_comment: Qwen-Image-2.1 MASKED inpaint (int8_convrot files). Source + mask uploaded; VAEEncodeForInpaint carries the mask so ONLY the glass region is regenerated — foreground (legs, rainbow socks, dog, bed, couch, door frame) is hard-locked by the latent.

inputs.prompt: Look through the glass doors of this cozy night-time living room: replace the dark interior and its reflections with a view of a wooden tree fort built high in a dense tropical rainforest canopy overlooking the ocean. The tree fort has warm wooden planks and a rope railing, hung with glowing string lights, surrounded by lush green leaves framing the view. Beyond the canopy spread turquoise ocean water and a distant coast under warm golden-hued light. Do NOT change anything else: keep the wooden door frame, the door handles, and the central door mullion exactly as they are, and keep the foreground — the person's legs with rainbow-striped socks on the couch, the black fluffy dog on its gray bed, the couch, the rug — completely unchanged. Match the cozy, warm, dimly-lit night mood and muted earthy color palette.
inputs.negative_prompt: blurry, low quality, deformed legs, extra limbs, distorted dog, misshapen couch, broken door frame, missing door frame, warped mullion, text, watermark, signature, changed foreground, moved sofa, lens flare, oversaturated
